errors.share_disabled: Sharing is turned off on this Meshloom. An administrator can turn it on in the settings.
errors.share_community_off: Sharing needs Meshloom Community. Turn Community on first.
errors.share_unavailable: The share service cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
errors.share_quota_exceeded: This Meshloom has reached its share quota. Try again later.
errors.share_quota_key: This Meshloom has reached its daily share quota. Try again later.
errors.share_quota_ip: Too many shares from this network today. Try again later.
errors.share_quota_global: The share service has reached its daily limit. Try again later.
errors.share_rate_limited: Too many share requests at once. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.share_banned: The share service has blocked this Meshloom for 12 hours; existing links still open. A mistake? Write to ban@meshloom.app.
errors.share_too_large: This file is too large to share.
errors.share_type_refused: This type of file cannot be shared.
errors.share_not_found: This link or file does not exist.
errors.share_gone: This link or file expired or was removed.
errors.share_target_blocked: The share service refuses links to this address.
errors.share_cross_site: Sharing requests coming from another website are refused.
errors.share_invalid_id: This is not a valid shared object id.
errors.share_invalid_request: Unexpected parameter in a share request.
errors.share_role_forbidden: This account cannot open a shared object from a direct message.
errors.share_mode_unavailable: Encrypted sharing is not available yet.
errors.share_upload_timeout: The upload took too long to reach this Meshloom. Check the connection and try again.
errors.share_storage_failed: The file could not be stored (disk full?). An administrator should check the data folder.
errors.share_not_owner: This link or file was not shared from this Meshloom, so it cannot be deleted here.
errors.share_object_blocked: The share service blocked this link or file. It cannot be deleted; contact the service if you disagree.
errors.share_mode_not_allowed: Encrypted files are not possible in this conversation: send the photo in public mode.
errors.share_radio_key_unavailable: The radio's key isn't available here: not read yet, or out of reach through a proxy. Send in public mode, or connect the radio directly.
errors.share_undecryptable: This encrypted file cannot be decrypted in this conversation.
errors.share_radio_not_heard: No other station has heard this radio lately: send a flood advertisement, then try again.
errors.share_community_opted_out: This radio has left Meshloom Community: join it again in the Community settings.
errors.share_community_banned: Meshloom Community has blocked this radio; if this is a mistake, write to ban@meshloom.app.
errors.share_attestation_unavailable: Meshloom Community cannot vouch for this radio right now. Try again later.
errors.share_attestation_rejected: The service refused this radio's Community attestation. Try again later.
